mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 0.5pp rise trigger activates but SPX 5-day returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year for 3 consecutive months, it signals an overheating economy that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 3% trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines for two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS show YoY declines for 2 months but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market downturn that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 55 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% for two consecutive months, it signals a favorable environment of strong industrial activity and easy monetary policy that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and FEDFUNDS < 2% for 2 months but SPX 60-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals a regime of ultra-easy monetary policy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% for 2 months but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.
